title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README and agent guides to learn Football Life is a luck-based career sim driven by weighted wheels, not a match engine.

title: App Entry and Layouts
description: The root layout boots fonts and global styles; game and auth route groups wrap lobby, squad, draft, and login screens.

title: Auth Gate
description: Middleware refreshes the Supabase session and redirects guests to login; LoginForm and browser client handle sign-in/register.

title: Lobby and Squad Board
description: Game lobby lists sessions; squad board renders the formation pitch and opens draft slots for career players.

title: Draft Drum Career Loop
description: DraftDrumScreen and useDraftDrum orchestrate setup wheels, season simulation, competition flows, and retirement.

title: Wheel Engine Core
description: Weight calculator builds deterministic pools and OVR formulas; spin-resolver is the only place Math.random is allowed.

title: Career State and Club Sync
description: useCareerStats owns career progression and enforces currentClub + currentContinentalCup updates together on transfers.

title: Season Simulation Services
description: Domain services simulate seasons, tables, cups, transfers, and stat evolution; Server Actions wrap them with auth and Zod.

title: Data Model
description: Prisma schema defines GameSession and CareerPlayer; RLS lockdown SQL hardens Supabase table access.

title: Domain Types
description: Shared game and squad types keep ClientSafePlayer free of hiddenStats and define season/step schemas for the UI.

title: Architecture Docs
description: Architecture, state-management, and module-boundary docs explain layer rules: UI renders, services decide, actions mutate.
